tales.title: The 1950 Asylum
tales.description: October 1950. Investigators enter Blackwood Asylum, where patients vanish at night and Dr. Hale's treatments go far beyond medicine. A horror quest in four chapters. Sounds from Shattered Pixel Dungeon, Stendhal, Battle for Wesnoth, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, /tg/station 13, Red Eclipse, Flare, OpenSFX (OpenTTD) and Hypersomnia (see the Troubadour sound credits).

tales.title: The Haunted Church
tales.description: The bells of Saint-Aubin have been silent for forty years. Tonight they ring at midnight. A ghost story in four chapters, from the nave to the bell tower. Sounds from Battle for Wesnoth, Stendhal, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, /tg/station 13, Hypersomnia, Flare, Shattered Pixel Dungeon, Red Eclipse, OpenClonk and Unknown Horizons (see the Troubadour sound credits).

tales.title: Werewolf
tales.description: Run a game of Loup Garou: the village debates and votes by day, the werewolves hunt by night. Sounds from Stendhal, Battle for Wesnoth, 0 A.D. and Flare (see the Troubadour sound credits).
chapters: Day: the village and the vote
